PAPABURY QUEBECBURY ROMEOBURY

Incident page for this loss

Name: 1LT Quebecbury Romeobury Papabury
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: HMM-161
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 04/23/1969; duty: Aircraft Commander.
Service: U.S. Marine Corps; reserve component
Country: South Vietnam
Aircraft: CH-46D tail number 153336
Short Summary: Aircraft commander of the second ship into the zone; hit by fire, it rolled down the hill and pinned the pilots for 7 hours; he died of internal bleeding.
Military grid coordinates of event: YD013643
Location: Quang Tri Province I Corps.
Primary cause: Hostile Fire
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
